title: A shell stays with you
hook: Two animals carry very different coverings.

knows: Animals have body structures and interact with their surroundings.
doesNotKnow: The turtle outline connects its shell to its own ribs and spine, while the separate spiral represents a borrowed hermit crab shell. These are simplified diagrams, not complete anatomical reconstructions.

misconception: The observed arrangement has a different effect than the one shown.
objective: Why can a turtle not leave its shell as a hermit crab leaves a borrowed shell?
